evals.prompt: I'm the maintenance superintendent at a gas processing plant. Here is the ProbeMatrix findings export from our investigation of last year's gas terminal fire: samples/<incident>/<export>.xlsx. What should my shift in-charges and maintenance supervisors take away from this? I need something I can actually use in next week's supervisors' meeting.

Our board safety committee meets next month. Using this ProbeMatrix investigation export (samples/<incident>/<export>.xlsx), prepare the briefing paper for the directors: what does this incident tell the board about oversight and assurance, and what should directors ask management?

Can you turn this ProbeMatrix investigation (samples/<incident>/<export>.xlsx) into an organisation-wide learning plan - who in the organisation needs to learn what, at which level - with a dashboard I can open in a browser and a lessons-learned register spreadsheet?
